notes_review: The logged calls are sound: Marx defines commodity, use-value, exchange-value, value, magnitude of value and socially necessary labor-time himself in this section, so leaving out the §7 glosses is right. Using only the first sentence of the labor-power gloss in p013 is justified, because the second sentence would bring in the wage relation before Ch. 1 reaches it.
summary: Every claim, hedge, number, inference word and attribution checks out paragraph by paragraph, including the footnotes, the French translations and the Engels insertion in p019. The prose reads plainly at the target level and no glossary or spelling drift was found.
